scenes.summary: After saving the Tianshi, you are surprised to discover that Ardashir not only disabled the Tianshi Pillar, he also tore open a rift. You tell the Tianshi to evacuate and make preparations to restart the Pillar to prevent things from getting worse and eliminate the potential threat.

lines.text: Is this Ardashir's power... The color is just so weird... And is that ... a rift?
Wait! Don't get any closer —
YSTF. We'll handle this.
A way to contain the rift must be found.
Tianshi Pillar? It can keep the rift contained — Err, I mean, if it still works...
I, I know a way to restart the Pillar —
Get back to the city.
Direct contact with the rift is too dangerous for you.
...Much appreciated. Thank you.
If the commander's aim is to keep them safe, then they should leave. It's as simple as that.
Anyway, restarting the Tianshi Pillar can be achieved with just Chen and I.
I hope you have not forgotten the training you had.
Hey, stop saying that! My grades were just as good as yours!
Seems like it... Depth readings are extremely abnormal. When the Tianshi Pillars were damaged, rifts began to appear. This is definitely the power of Æther.
Is this the work of Ardashir's Arts...? Is he now capable of tearing new rifts?
Sorry about this. We wanted to help too.
I know the dangers of the rift ... too well, in fact. The disaster from the past must not strike again.
Wha?

options: Are these "swords" part of Ardashir's Arts?
This rift is nothing like those in Valley IV.
If this rift continues to grow...
We can't let this go unchecked.
You're actually worried about them, right?
It wasn't the delays. It was them you're worried about, right?

scenes.summary: Arcane uses her special Yinglung Special Task Force abilities to defeat Ardashir's Arts and successfully re-activate the Tianshi Pillar. Perlica and Chen Qianyu keenly sense that the attack on Cloudrest Woods is Ardashir's feint to distract you. You realize that this foe must be taken down quickly so that the forces of Wuling can regain the initiative.

lines.text: I'll handle the rift.
YSTF is your go-to specialist for handling Ætherside disasters... This should be a piece of cake for her.
It's Ardashir's Arts—!
I'll break it.
...It's done.
No matter. Just move fast and neutralize Ardashir. That will help Wuling regain the initiative.
Let's go to the Lake Islet.
Hmm. If this is his attempt to delay us...
Then perhaps Tianshi Zhuang and I made the right guess. This is just an obvious feint to lure us to this place.
But his feint hit the Marker Stone and made a rift. We can't just ignore it...
...I have a feeling that he's doing it to get the Endmin to come here.

options: Though we were delayed for a while...
Time to get to the Marker Stone, and fast.

scenes.summary: You arrive at Lake Islet and, surprisingly, there is no sign of strong enemy presence. Ardashir uses an entity under his control to express his goodwill. Arcane, however, makes the decisive call and leads the way to help you reach the entrance of the Marker Stone.

lines.text: Hold on. Contact.
You are here.
This thing...?! It talks?!
Just as I've said at Qingbo Stockade. We meet again.
Endministrator—
Quiet.
I'll lead the way.
An impatient one...

options: It speaks with the voice of Ardashir...
...Find a way. Don't let it distract us!

scenes.summary: As you approach the Marker Stone entrance, you realize that Ardashir has manifested an Ætherside barrier that blocks your way. He then recommends another option. You reject him without hesitation and prepare yourself to eradicate the enemy and cut your way through.

lines.text: The Æther has acquired a visible form... It has become "sword" and "wall"...
These phantoms are closing in on us!
You should have guessed that my objectives are the Very Large Rift ... and you, Endministrator.
Come and face me. Accept our inevitable battle...
Or head back to Wuling, and bring the innocent away from the vicinity of the Rift.
...Then I shall patiently wait for you at the Marker Stone.
That being said ... I have yet to personally assess the extent of your vestigial powers.
Take out these phantoms. Then open the entrance!
Forgive my trespasses, Endministrator.
I think I've ... seen these before...
If you comply, I shall persuade Nefarith to abandon violence. Killing the Terrans will only impede our enterprise.
You have no right to tell people to leave their homes.
Endmin!

scenes.summary: While activating the auxiliary pillars, you run into two Qingbo Stockaders you have met before. They claim to be searching from their grandfather's relic at the Marker Stone but ended up being trapped at this place. Arcane prepares to eliminate them but Chen and you stop her in time.

lines.text: I say we should keep hiding in the water...
We can't hide forever! The entire thing blew up in our faces. Wuling is gonna make us pay —
Cangzei pirates? Up to no good again.
HOLD ON! We're just trying to help!
Hmm. You look familiar... Oh! It's you! The pair of sneaks who ran away from Qingbo Stockade!
Working for Ardashir?
Huh? Arda who...?
Got no time to question them. I'll just eliminate the risks.
Just, don't! They're definitely not working for him!
Yeh-YEAH! We're trapped here too!
We sneaked through the secret tunnel to find our grampa's stuff...
Ahem, yeah, we, uh, dug that tunnel back when the Stockade Fam planned to raid Wuling...
Err... Hah... It's hard to believe, but I can't do nothing about it...
We were trying to visit grampa one last time ... before we hightail out of this place. Curse our luck...
So you were trying to activate the auxiliary pillar?
And I saw Tianshi fiddling with something similar! If we switch it on, a path will definitely appear!
Did you... just let them go like that? You used to be way less forgiving...
I do not question the Endmin's orders.
Ahem. Endmin, let's activate the auxiliary pillar.
Wait, wait, wait!
We gotta make it work or there'll be no way out!
...Head down the way we came from. There will be a raft station. The raft should still be there.
Oh, thank you so much! We mean it!
Once again you've saved our lives!

options: Your grampa left stuff at the Marker Stone?
I don't think they're lying. Let them go.
We shouldn't waste time here. Let them go.
